title.zh: OpenAI让近2000个Agent并行搞科研：32分钟分析800万脑细胞，找到神经疾病新线索
title.en: OpenAI让近2000个Agent并行搞科研：32分钟分析800万脑细胞，找到神经疾病新线索

current_state.zh: OpenAI, PerturbAI and Scripps used 1,946 GPT-Rosalind agents to analyze about 8 million mouse brain cells in 32 minutes, surfacing candidate mechanisms for DCTN1-related Parkinson-like disease and distinct Tsc1/Tsc2 regulatory effects.
